## Outline

- (15m) Posit Assistant
  - Demo [`_demos/23_demo_assistant`](https://github.com/posit-conf-2026/llms/tree/main/_demos/23_demo_assistant): Posit Assistant explores `data/airbnb-austin.csv` with its read, write, and skill tools. The instructor starts the conversation, then everyone explores on their own.
  - Discussion: what keeps an assistant that runs code safe?
    - Permission prompts, sandboxing, and LLM-based safety checks
    - Reference: [Help! My coding agent can run code](https://tidydesign.substack.com/p/help-my-coding-agent-can-run-code)
  - Free practice time in the tool attendees will actually use

## Further reading

- [Help! My coding agent can run code](https://tidydesign.substack.com/p/help-my-coding-agent-can-run-code) — sandboxing, permission prompts, and LLM-based safety checks.
- [Auto mode knows it's dangerous (and does it anyway)](https://tidydesign.substack.com/p/auto-mode-knows-its-dangerous-and) — a cautionary experiment with `curl | sh` installers.
